kv2.10:1.3: lokuttare sote paṭihaññati no lokiyo, lokuttarena viññāṇena paṭivijānanti no lokiyena, sāvakā paṭivijānanti no puthujjanā’ti.
kv2.10:2.1: nanu buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiye sote paṭihaññatī’ti.
kv2.10:2.3: hañci buddhassa bhagavato vohāre lokiye sote paṭihaññati, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv2.10:3.1: nanu buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ lokiyena viññāṇena paṭivijānantī’ti.
kv2.10:3.3: hañci buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ lokiyena viññāṇena paṭivijānanti, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv2.10:4.1: nanu buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ puthujjanā paṭivijānantī’ti.
kv2.10:4.3: hañci buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ puthujjanā paṭivijānanti, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv2.10:5.3: magge phalaṃ nibbānaṃ sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ sakadāgāmimaggo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ anāgāmimaggo anāgāmiphalaṃ arahattamaggo arahattaphalaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ sammappadhānaṃ iddhipādo indriyaṃ balaṃ bojjhaṅgo’ti.
kv2.10:6.3: atthī keci buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇantī’ti.
kv2.10:6.5: lokuttaro dhammo sotaviññeyyo sotasmiṃ paṭihaññati, sotassa āpāthaṃ āgacchatī’ti.
kv2.10:7.1: nanu lokuttaro dhamme na sotaviññeyyo na sotasmiṃ paṭihaññati, na sotassa āpāthaṃ āgacchatī’ti.
kv2.10:7.3: hañci lokuttaro dhammo na sotaviññeyyo na sotasmiṃ paṭihaññati na sotassa āpāthaṃ āgacchati, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv2.10:8.3: atthī keci buddhassa bhagavato vohāre rajjeyyunti.
kv2.10:8.5: lokuttaro dhammo rāgaṭṭhāniyo rajanīyo kamanīyo madanīyo bandhanīyo mucchanīyo’ti.
kv2.10:9.1: nanu lokuttaro dhammo na rāgaṭṭhāniyo na rajanīyo na kamanīyo na madanīyo na bandhanīyo na mucchanīyo’ti.
kv2.10:9.3: hañci lokuttaro dhammo na rāgaṭṭhāniyo na rajanīyo na kamanīyo na madanīyo na bandhanīyo na mucchanīyo, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv2.10:10.3: atthī keci buddhassa bhagavato vohāre dusseyyunti.
kv2.10:11.1: nanu lokuttaro dhamme na dosaṭṭhānīyo na kopaṭṭhānīyo na paṭighaṭṭhānīyo’ti.
kv2.10:11.3: hañci lokuttaro dhammo na dosaṭṭhānīyo na kopaṭṭhānīyo na paṭighaṭṭhānīyo, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv2.10:12.3: atthī keci buddhassa bhagavato vohāre muyheyyunti.
kv2.10:12.5: lokuttaro dhammo mohaṭṭhāniyo aññāṇakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko’ti.
kv2.10:13.1: nanu lokuttaro dhammo na mohaṭṭhāniyo na aññāṇakaraṇo na acakkhukaraṇo paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko’ti.
kv2.10:13.3: hañci lokuttaro dhammo na mohaṭṭhāniyo na aññāṇakaraṇo na acakkhukaraṇo paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv2.10:14.3: ye keci buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇanti, sabbe te maggaṃ bhāventī’ti.
kv2.10:15.1: ye keci buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇanti, sabbe te maggaṃ bhāventī’ti
kv2.10:15.3: bālaputhujjanā buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇanti, bālaputhujjanā maggaṃ bhāventī’ti.
kv2.10:15.9: saṅghabhedakā buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇanti. saṅghabhedakā maggaṃ bhāventī’ti.
kv2.10:16.1: labbhā sovaṇṇamayāya laṭṭhiyā dhaññapuñjo’pi suvaṇṇapuñjo’pi ācikkhitunti.
kv2.10:16.3: evamevaṃ bhagavā lokuttarena vohārena lokiyampi lokuttarampi dhammaṃ voharatī’ti.
kv2.10:17.1: labbhā eḷaṇḍiyāya laṭṭhiyā dhaññapuñjo’pi suvaṇṇapuñjā’pi acikkhitunti.
kv2.10:17.3: evamevaṃ bhagavā lokiyena vohārena lokiyampi lokuttarampi dhammaṃ voharati’ti.
kv2.10:18.1: buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyā hoti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttaro hotī’ti.
kv2.10:18.3: lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiye sote paṭihaññati, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttare sote paṭihaññati,
kv2.10:18.4: lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyena viññāṇena paṭivijānanti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttarena viññāṇena paṭivijānanti,
kv2.10:18.5: lokiyaṃ voharantassa puthujjanā paṭivijānanti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa sāvakā paṭivijānantī’ti.
kv2.10:19.2: buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyo hoti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttaro hotī’ti.
kv2.10:19.4: nanu bhagavā lokiyampi lokuttarampi dhammaṃ voharatī’ti.
kv2.10:19.6: hañci bhagavā lokiyampi lokuttarampi dhammaṃ voharati, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv2.10:19.7: buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyo hoti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttaro hotī’ti.
kv2.10:20.1: buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyo hoti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttaro hotī’ti.
kv2.10:20.3: maggaṃ voharantassa magge hoti, amaggaṃ voharantassa amaggo hoti, phalaṃ voharantassa phalaṃ hoti, aphalaṃ voharantassa aphalaṃ hoti, nibbānaṃ voharantassa nibbānaṃ hoti, anibbānaṃ voharantassa anibbānaṃ hoti, saṅkhataṃ voharantassa saṅkhataṃ hoti, asaṅkhataṃ voharantassa asaṅkhataṃ hoti, rūpaṃ voharantassa rūpaṃ hoti, arūpaṃ voharantassa arūpaṃ hoti, vedanaṃ voharantassa vedanā hoti, avedanaṃ voharantassa avedanā hoti, saññaṃ voharantassa saññā hoti, asaññaṃ voharantassa asaññā hoti, saṅkhāre voharantassa saṅkhārā honti, asaṅkhāre voharantassa asaṅkhārā honti, viññāṇaṃ voharantassa viññāṇaṃ hoti, aviññāṇaṃ voharantassa aviññāṇaṃ hotīti.
